about.title: About us
about.text: Vila Boska Palić with a garden view is located in the town of Palić and offers a restaurant, shared lounge, bar, garden, outdoor seasonal pool and terrace. Free WiFi and private parking at Vila Boska Palic are available. Some units feature a flat-screen TV with cable channels, a fully equipped kitchen with a fridge, and a private bathroom with a shower and free toiletries. Vila Boska Palic also provides barbecue facilities.
